svg.title: What a corpus holds: two surfaces over one grid
svg.desc: Two surfaces over the grid of resolutions by CRFs, both coloured by VMAF. Left, VMAF: near 100 at low CRF and high resolution, falling to under 5 at 270p and CRF 48. Right, bitrate on a log scale: from about 29 megabits per second at 1080p and CRF 13 to 40 kilobits at 270p and CRF 48. Vertical bars show how far titles differ at each point.
svg.text: What a corpus holds: two surfaces over one grid
30 titles of 30 s, each encoded at 5 resolutions × 11 CRFs. Height: the mean of the corpus. Bars: from its lowest title to its highest, at each of the 55 points.
VMAF of the corpus, on both surfaces:
corpus mean, from its lowest to its highest title
